media.title: Classic Developmental Psychology Demonstration: The Strange Situation Procedure (8-Episode Observation Playroom)

analysis.method: R67 quarantined shot-boundary & optical-flow geometric extraction (08_reenactment_edl.json, zero raw pixels stored in repository)

timecodes.what: Wide angle behind observation glass overlooking the sunlit playroom with two adult chairs and floor toy mat
Caregiver seated in right chair while one-year-old toddler explores floor toys at center playmat as a secure base
Unfamiliar female stranger enters, sits quietly in left chair with reading folio, then kneels to engage toddler with floor toys
First separation: caregiver slips out the right-hand clinic door; stranger kneels to offer comfort while toddler protests toward door
First reunion: caregiver re-enters doorway, picks up and calms toddler, then resettles child on floor mat as stranger exits
Second separation: caregiver exits leaving toddler completely alone in playroom; stranger returns at 02:48 unable to console
Second reunion: caregiver returns through right doorway, lifts toddler into immediate calm embrace within seconds
